'''Crunglor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who was active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he was known for his cruel personality. He was eventually killed near [[Outpost Rennar]], in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Encounter" />
